summary: Brera Holdings PLC (now operating as Solmate Infrastructure) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a July 30, 2026 press release announcing a strategic partnership with Kraken Institutional. Under a commercial agreement, Kraken will provide qualified custody and validator infrastructure for Solmate's Solana staking operations, enhancing staking economics and recurring revenue. CEO Ron Sade and Kraken's Lincoln Bartlett commented. No financial terms, ownership stakes, prices, or shareholder votes were disclosed. The filing is a routine business development announcement, not a special situation; it does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, or other event on the specified list.
